##### Project general facts

Mama Residences Dubai is a distinctive branded residential development in Business Bay that brings the bold character and signature hospitality of the renowned Mama Shelter brand to Dubai. Developed by Ennismore and designed by Franklin Azzi Architecture with interiors by celebrated French designer Thierry Gaugain, the tower is a striking architectural landmark that blends contemporary design with artistic expression. Every residence reflects a vibrant, lifestyle-driven concept where luxury, creativity, and comfort come together to create an inspiring place to live.

Residents enjoy a fully serviced lifestyle enhanced by premium hospitality and an exceptional selection of amenities. Designed to foster relaxation, social connection, and everyday convenience, the development combines the atmosphere of a luxury hotel with the privacy of a permanent residence. Its prime Business Bay location places Downtown Dubai, the Dubai Canal, world-class restaurants, shopping, and entertainment just moments away, offering an energetic urban lifestyle in one of the city's most prestigious districts.

The residences feature carefully selected premium materials, sophisticated contemporary finishes, and integrated Smart Home technology that enhances comfort and convenience. Modern kitchens come fully equipped with integrated appliances, while every residence is delivered fully furnished with bold designer interiors that reflect Mama's unique creative identity. The fully serviced homes provide a seamless turnkey living experience where style, functionality, and exceptional hospitality meet.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay, Dubai, can be confusing due to its name. However, it’s not just office spaces and buildings. There are hotel towers, amazing restaurants and wonderful residential properties here as well. It is known to be a very stylish and up-to-date in the latest trends and gadgets kind of community. The life here is face-paced. 

Business Bay is on the south side of Downtown Dubai. This area usually hosts plenty of events to keep things lively. There are music festivals, Mother’s Day celebrations, New Year’s celebrations and many others as well. The lifestyle that Business Bay offers has many advantages.

Famous and international schools, medicals, supermarkets, banks and finance centers are a few minutes from your space. The place simply elevates your life standard and way of living with easy and intuitive options in the proximity. Come and seek refuge in this wonderful place full of potential elements of pleasures, success and fun.
